cases.expected: returns a non‑null JsonSchema instance whose meta‑schema version matches the schema content
cases.description: Happy‑path: a valid classpath URI points to an existing JSON Schema file; the factory should load the file, parse it and return a usable JsonSchema object.

cases.expected: throws NullPointerException (or IllegalArgumentException) because the supplied SchemaLocation is null
cases.description: Validate that the method guards against a null argument and fails fast.

cases.expected: throws IllegalArgumentException indicating an unsupported URI scheme
cases.description: The factory only supports http, https, classpath and file schemes; an unsupported scheme should cause an explicit exception.

cases.expected: throws JsonSchemaException (or IOException) because the resource cannot be found
cases.description: When the location points to a resource that does not exist, the loader must surface the error.

cases.expected: returns a JsonSchema whose meta‑schema IRI is "http://json-schema.org/draft-07/schema#"
cases.description: Meta‑schema URIs are treated specially; the factory should recognise the IRI and return a JsonSchema that represents the draft‑07 meta‑schema.

cases.expected: returns a non‑null JsonSchema that corresponds to the normalized path (i.e., classpath:/schemas/base-schema.json)
cases.description: The method should normalise relative path components ("..", ".") before loading the schema.

cases.expected: throws JsonSchemaException because the file exists but does not contain a valid JSON Schema document
cases.description: Even if the file is reachable, an empty or malformed JSON document must be detected and reported.

cases.expected: returns a non‑null JsonSchema instance whose meta‑schema version matches the $schema keyword in the file (e.g., "http://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema#")
cases.description: Happy‑path for a file‑system URI: the file exists and contains a correct JSON Schema; the factory should read, parse and return a usable JsonSchema.

cases.expected: returns a non‑null JsonSchema instance representing the remote schema
cases.description: Valid HTTP URI where the remote resource is reachable (e.g., via a test HTTP server or WireMock). The method must perform an HTTP GET, parse the response and produce a JsonSchema.

cases.expected: returns a JsonSchema that can resolve the external $ref defined in the schema (e.g., a definition located at classpath:/schemas/definitions.json)
cases.description: Schema contains a $ref to another schema file. The factory must load the referenced schema and attach it to the resulting JsonSchema so that validation would succeed for referenced definitions.

cases.expected: returns a JsonSchema instance without throwing StackOverflowError; circular $ref is detected and handled via lazy resolution
cases.description: Schema has a self‑referencing $ref (direct or indirect). The factory should create the JsonSchema without entering an infinite recursion.

cases.expected: returns a non‑null JsonSchema instance; the URL‑encoded space is correctly decoded and the resource is loaded
cases.description: Schema location contains URL‑encoded characters (e.g., %20). The method must decode the path before locating the resource.

cases.expected: throws IllegalArgumentException indicating that the location does not point to a file containing a JSON Schema
cases.description: The supplied URI points to a directory rather than a file; the factory should reject it early.

cases.expected: returns a non‑null JsonSchema instance; query parameters are ignored during loading
cases.description: Schema URI includes a query string. The loader must strip the query part and load the underlying file.

cases.expected: the two calls to getSchema with the same SchemaLocation return the identical JsonSchema instance (reference equality)
cases.description: Verifies that the factory caches schemas; repeated requests for the same location should return the same object, not a new instance.

cases.expected: throws JsonSchemaException (or IOException) because the content is not valid JSON
cases.description: The resource exists but contains malformed JSON (e.g., missing a closing brace). The factory must detect the parsing error and surface an appropriate exception.

cases.expected: IllegalArgumentException (malformed URI syntax)
cases.description: The supplied URI string cannot be parsed according to RFC 2396; the factory should reject it with an IllegalArgumentException.

cases.expected: JsonSchemaException (or IOException) indicating HTTP 404 Not Found
cases.description: The HTTP endpoint exists but returns a 404 status; the loader must surface the error rather than returning a schema.

cases.expected: JsonSchemaException (or IOException) indicating HTTP 500 Internal Server Error
cases.description: A remote server error should be propagated as a JsonSchemaException/IOException.

cases.expected: JsonSchemaException (or IOException) because the response body is not valid JSON
cases.description: The HTTP resource returns HTML (or any non‑JSON content); parsing must fail and an exception should be thrown.

cases.expected: IOException (or JsonSchemaException) caused by AccessDeniedException
cases.description: The file exists but the process lacks read permission; loading the schema should raise an I/O‑related exception.

cases.expected: IllegalArgumentException indicating an unsupported URI scheme
cases.description: Only http, https, classpath and file schemes are supported; a mailto scheme must be rejected.

cases.expected: IllegalArgumentException because fragment identifiers are not allowed in schema locations
cases.description: A SchemaLocation containing a URI fragment should be considered invalid for loading a whole schema.

cases.expected: JsonSchemaException indicating an unknown $schema meta‑schema IRI
cases.description: The schema contains a $schema value that does not correspond to any registered meta‑schema; the factory must fail.

cases.expected: JsonSchemaException because a $ref points to a non‑existent external schema
cases.description: During loading the factory encounters a $ref that cannot be resolved; this should result in an exception.

cases.expected: JsonSchemaException (or IOException) because the default loader expects JSON and the content is YAML
cases.description: A schema file with a .yaml extension is supplied without specifying InputFormat; the loader should reject the unsupported format.

cases.expected: SecurityException indicating access to the classpath resource is denied
cases.description: When a SecurityManager blocks access to the requested classpath resource, the factory must propagate the SecurityException.
